
SUGGEST-DEPENDENCIES
Auto-suggest dependency relationships based on work unit metadata (sequential IDs, build/test pairs, infrastructure patterns)

WHEN TO USE
  Use this command when setting up new work units or auditing existing relationships. Especially valuable after bulk work unit creation to quickly establish dependencies based on naming conventions and sequential IDs. Reduces manual relationship mapping effort.

PREREQUISITES
  • spec/work-units.json exists with multiple work units

USAGE
  fspec suggest-dependencies [options]

OPTIONS
  --output <format>
    Output format: json or text
    Default: text

COMMON PATTERNS
  • Bulk Dependency Setup
    Example: # Create work units with sequential IDs
fspec create-story AUTH "Setup auth infrastructure"
fspec create-story AUTH "Add login endpoint"
fspec create-story AUTH "Add logout endpoint"

# Get suggestions
fspec suggest-dependencies

# Apply HIGH confidence suggestions automatically
fspec add-dependency AUTH-002 --depends-on AUTH-001
fspec add-dependency AUTH-003 --depends-on AUTH-001
    undefined

  • Test/Build Pattern Recognition
    Example: # Create build and test work units
fspec create-task BUILD "Build authentication module"
fspec create-task TEST "Test authentication module"

# Get suggestions (will detect test depends on build)
fspec suggest-dependencies

# Apply suggested dependency
fspec add-dependency TEST-001 --depends-on BUILD-001
    undefined

  • Infrastructure-First Pattern
    Example: # Create schema and feature work
fspec create-task SCHEMA "Database schema setup"
fspec create-story ADD "Add user management features"

# Get suggestions (will detect feature depends on schema)
fspec suggest-dependencies

# Apply infrastructure dependency
fspec add-dependency ADD-001 --depends-on SCHEMA-001
    undefined


TYPICAL WORKFLOW
  1. Create work units with consistent naming → 2. Run suggestions: fspec suggest-dependencies → 3. Review suggestions (prioritize HIGH confidence) → 4. Apply dependencies: fspec add-dependency <from-id> --depends-on=<to-id> → 5. Verify: fspec show-work-unit <id>

EXAMPLES
  1. Get dependency suggestions based on patterns
  $ fspec suggest-dependencies
  Found 5 dependency suggestion(s):

1. AUTH-002 → AUTH-001 (dependsOn)
   ● sequential IDs in AUTH prefix suggest AUTH-002 depends on AUTH-001
   Confidence: MEDIUM

2. TEST-AUTH-001 → BUILD-AUTH-001 (dependsOn)
   ● test work depends on build work: "Test authentication" depends on "Build authentication"
   Confidence: HIGH

3. FEAT-001 → SCHEMA-001 (dependsOn)
   ● infrastructure work (schema/migration) should complete before feature work: "Add user features" depends on "Database schema setup"
   Confidence: HIGH

To apply a suggestion: fspec add-dependency <from-id> --depends-on=<to-id>

  2. Output suggestions as JSON for automation
  $ fspec suggest-dependencies --output json
  {
  "suggestions": [
    {
      "from": "AUTH-002",
      "to": "AUTH-001",
      "type": "dependsOn",
      "reason": "sequential IDs in AUTH prefix suggest AUTH-002 depends on AUTH-001",
      "confidence": "medium"
    },
    {
      "from": "TEST-AUTH-001",
      "to": "BUILD-AUTH-001",
      "type": "dependsOn",
      "reason": "test work depends on build work",
      "confidence": "high"
    }
  ]
}

  3. Show only high-confidence suggestions
  $ fspec suggest-dependencies | grep HIGH
  2. TEST-AUTH-001 → BUILD-AUTH-001 (dependsOn)
   ● test work depends on build work: "Test authentication" depends on "Build authentication"
   Confidence: HIGH

COMMON ERRORS
  ✗ Error: No dependency suggestions found
    Fix: No patterns detected (sequential IDs, build/test pairs, infrastructure keywords). Suggestions require consistent naming conventions.

  ✗ Error: work-units.json not found
    Fix: Run: fspec init to create work-units.json file

  ✗ Error: Invalid work-units.json format
    Fix: Check for JSON syntax errors in spec/work-units.json

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-dependency
  fspec query-bottlenecks
  fspec query-orphans
  fspec remove-dependency
  fspec show-work-unit
  fspec validate-dependencies

NOTES
  • Suggestion Rules:
  •   1. Sequential IDs: AUTH-002 depends on AUTH-001 (same prefix)
  •   2. Build/Test pairs: "Test X" depends on "Build X"
  •   3. Infrastructure-first: Features depend on schema/migration work
  •   4. Same epic: Suggests relatesTo (low confidence)
  •   5. Circular dependencies are automatically filtered out
  • Confidence levels:
  •   HIGH: Build/test pairs, infrastructure patterns (apply immediately)
  •   MEDIUM: Sequential IDs (review before applying)
  • Existing dependencies are excluded from suggestions
  • Specific patterns (build/test, infrastructure) override generic sequential suggestions
